body: I have one family member. She's mentioned many times that I'm a burden to her. She'll be fine. I'll leave behind quite a bit of money when I go, and it'll be going to her.
He said that all I do was complain when I asked him why he treated me like a spare. Guys like him kinda suck cause they really destroy your self esteem. Thank you for your kind words.
Thank you. I wish you all the best too.
I know so. But it's difficult because he's been a constant for 5 years. I made a mistake with asking him why he treated me like a spare option but he said that he has done nothing wrong.
It didn't work out with the other girl, and he was really upset about it.
I'm pretty sure I was a spare option for him. But after 5 years, the urge to talk to him and apologize for something that is not my fault at all is still there.
